description: This file defines the ConfigurationImage class, which manages binary configuration data, including headers, content, cloning, and content extraction.

classes.name: ConfigurationImage
classes.description: A class to manage binary configuration data for an application, including handling headers, content, and cloning.

methods.name: ConfigurationImage
methods.description: Constructor to initialize content with a specified size or from an existing byte array.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the content byte array.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Static method to extract the actual configuration content from a ROM byte array by removing the header.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the internal content byte array.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ConfigurationImage instance.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns a specific range of bytes from the content, given an offset and size.
